The failure was a false positive in the program checker. It rejected the word "input" in two of my comments, not any real I/O call. I reworded those comments. I also replaced the garbled CMRR expression with the standard approximation: CMRR ≈ A1·2·gm3/gds_tail. The circuit topology and sizing are unchanged.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (17.0, 12.0, 22.0),     # diff pair (weak-ish inversion, low Vgs for headroom)
    "L1":    (1.5, 0.5, 3.0),        # diff pair L (gain + flicker area)
    "Itail": (20e-6, 12e-6, 40e-6),
    "I2":    (60e-6, 35e-6, 90e-6),  # second-stage current
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # PMOS mirror load + M6 (same density -> low systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmidn": (13.0, 9.0, 17.0),      # NMOS bias mirror family (ref, tail, M7)
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 3.0),
    "Cc":    (4e-12, 2e-12, 7e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.6, 1.8),        # Rz = rzk*(1+CL/Cc)/gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I2, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I2"], p["Cc"]
    Ih = It / 2

    # NMOS bias family (same gm/Id, L -> W scales with current)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I2, vds=0.9)
    # differential pair
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ih, vds=0.6, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and 2nd stage (same density)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ih, vds=0.75)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I2, vds=0.9)

    gm6 = m6.gm
    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1.0 + cl / Cc) / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on output side -> vinp non-inverting overall
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = gm6 / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    p2 = gm6 / (2 * PI * (cl + 2 * m6.cgd))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (3 * p2))) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I2 / (cl + Cc))
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I2)
    swing = 1.8 - 2.0 / p["gmidp"] - 2.0 / p["gmidn"]
    cmrr_db = db(a1 * 2 * m3.gm / max(mt.gds, 1e-12))
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 5.0 / (2 * PI * ugbw)
    noise = math.sqrt(16 * 1.38e-23 * 300 / (3 * gm1)) * 2.5
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew, "power": power,
               "swing": swing, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "settle": settle,
               "noise_1k": noise}
```
